mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 7.5% signals labor market weakness that triggers central bank easing, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor-housing decoupling, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST declines and PAYEMS increases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 99.0 signals manufacturing slowdown that precedes stock market correction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 99.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 850.0 thousand units signals residential sector contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST < 850.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPI rise above 230 (CPIAUCSL) and FEDFUNDS decline below 0.1% signals inflation response policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 420,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when RSAFS > 420,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Payrolls (PAYEMS) above 135,000 thousand persons signals strong labor market supporting corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when PAYEMS > 135,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
